comment: Read at the v2.0.0 tag, commit fdc34da. Every commit in the repository carries version 2.0.0, since plugin.json has been touched once, so the tag is what settles which source describes the shipped build; the fourteen commits after it are CI, documentation and two static-analysis fixes, and the whole delta was checked line by line for behaviour. It changes no name, no value and nothing in the audio path: Median3 is rewritten to the same function, the FX save and load walk the same four bytes through an array of pointers instead of pointer arithmetic, an #error becomes a static_assert, and the vendored firmware sync to 1.17 adds default initialisers the maker records as leaving the firmware byte-identical. No user-visible string differs between the two ends, so both describe this module identically. Two parameters have no widget at all: FUNC1_PARAM and FUNC2_PARAM, the per-voice function slots, are configured and read but never added to the panel, because on the hardware the Func encoder is the only way to them. They are absent from paramPos, so no click can reach them, and they get no line and no tag; the encoder itself is a plain Widget rather than a ParamWidget and is equally unreachable, so what it does is written as Notes. Every configInput and configOutput is called once with its own enum. Widget order does not follow enum order: the params are added as MODE, RATE, A, B, TONE - indices 6, 4, 2, 3, 5 - and the four input jacks run CV A, CV B, Clk/VOct, Sync across the panel, which is indices 0, 1, 3, 2, since the enum declares SYNC before CLK_VOCT while the production legends put Clk third. Tagged from the widget positions. The Clk/VOct input is left without a family: the Clk/VOct switch makes it either a clock or a 1V-per-octave pitch, so either colour would be wrong half the time. The maker's README and the code agree throughout; the numbers in the lines come from OghamApp.cpp - MapKnobToRate as two to the power of twelve times the knob minus six, giving a sixty-fourth to sixty-four times, CLOCK_RATIO_MAX_EXP of 5 giving a thirty-second to thirty-two times, VOCT_KNOB_SPAN_OCT of 2 giving an octave either way, and the LPG decay range from the field's own detail text.
